description: This file defines custom warning and validation logic for various Odoo models, including res.partner, sale.order, purchase.order, account.invoice, stock.picking, product.product, sale.order.line, and purchase.order.line. It adds warning messages and blocking alerts based on partner and product warning configurations.

classes.name: res_partner
classes.description: Extends res.partner with warning message fields for sales, purchases, stock, and invoices.

classes.name: sale_order
classes.description: Extends sale.order with onchange logic to display warnings or block based on partner warning settings.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Extends purchase.order with onchange logic for warnings based on partner warning settings.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extends account.invoice with onchange logic for warnings based on partner invoice warning settings.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extends stock.picking with onchange logic for warnings based on partner picking warning settings.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Adds warning message fields for sale and purchase order lines.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extends sale.order.line with product_id_change method to show warnings or block based on product warning settings.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Extends purchase.order.line with product_id_change method to show warnings or block based on product warning settings.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Handles partner change events for sale.order, purchase.order, and account.invoice to show warnings or block actions.

methods.name: onchange_partner_in
methods.description: Handles partner change event for stock.picking to show warnings or block actions.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Handles product selection change for sale.order.line and purchase.order.line to show warnings or block actions.
